A smaller prize is won if only three digits are matched (out of four digits). ong
What is the probability that a player wins the small prize?
Solution:
•
•

If exactly three digits are matched, one of the four digits must be incorrect and the other three digits
must be correct.
For the digit that is incorrect, there are 9 possible choices for the each digit (all but the one correct
digit).
Hence, by the sum rule, a total of 9 ways × 4 digits = 36 possible ways that match exactly three of
the winning four digits.
The probability is 36/10,000 = 9/2500 = 0.0036.
